Strict geometry: four equal square quadrants in reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; entire vignette in central 80% of each quadrant; pure white background; NO borders, divider, words, labels, letters, numbers or correctness symbols. Exactly match reference's thin slightly irregular charcoal pen outlines, dot eyes, simple solid dark hair, understated faces, rounded adult proportions, very flat muted colors. Other objects pale yellow, muted blue or white. White negative space, essentials only, no shadows, gradients, anime detail, textures or glossy finish.
